exposure: Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia Study Group (CDHSG) model
PCO2 values of blood gas in the first 24 h
cohort: The study analyzed data from 35 neonates treated for Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH).
finding: There was no significant difference found between the area under the curve values of the CDHSG model and PCO2 for predicting mortality risk in neonates with CDH.
